intro: Zoom for recruiters on Mac covers three jobs: scheduling candidate interviews, reusing saved templates, and recording calls to your own Mac. Templates and computer recording both need the Zoom Workplace desktop app, so start there. This guide covers each job in order, names the settings that matter, and shows where Lazur fits. Lazur is a voice assistant for your Mac. It points at things on your screen while you talk to it.
tldr: Schedule from Home > Schedule in the Zoom Workplace desktop app, or from the Calendar, Meetings, or Scheduler tabs.
Save a template with your waiting room, passcode and invite settings, so every candidate gets the same setup.
To record on your Mac, click Record in the meeting toolbar and choose Record on this Computer. Files land in Documents > Zoom.
Recurring meeting IDs expire 365 days after the last occurrence. Non-recurring IDs expire 30 days after scheduling.
Lazur helps by voice while you work. It points at buttons, answers questions and dictates notes. It never clicks for you.

blocks.text: What Zoom for recruiters on Mac covers day to day

Most recruiters use Zoom for three things. They book candidate calls, run the calls, and keep a record of what was said. Each job has its own menu path on Mac. Each one also has a setting that can save you an awkward moment. Zoom's help center has no page written for recruiters, so the steps below come from Zoom's general help articles and its release notes.

The app you need is the Zoom Workplace desktop app. Zoom's help pages now use that name. The current Mac build is 7.2.5 (build 90525). Zoom's release notes date it October 31, 2026. Check your build before a busy week, because the menus have moved several times this year.
How to schedule a Zoom interview on Mac

items: Open the Zoom Workplace desktop app and click Home in the left bar. If Home is not visible, click More, then Home.
Click Schedule. The New event window opens.
Type a topic that names the role and the stage, such as Phone screen: Data analyst.
Set the date and time. Add the candidate and any panel members as invitees.
Under Meeting Security, set a passcode and turn on the waiting room.
Click Save. With calendar integration on, choose Send, Don't send, or Back to editing.

blocks.text: You can also schedule from the Calendar, Meetings, or Scheduler tabs. The left bar is customizable. Drag or pin tabs to move them, and check the More tab for anything hidden. Zoom updated the interface in version 6.7.0.
Zoom meeting templates for recruiters on Mac

A template saves the settings you repeat for every candidate. In the scheduling window, use the Template option to apply a personal or account template. Two limits matter. Templates work only on Windows or macOS. They also need calendar integration turned on.

Build one template per interview stage. A phone screen needs a short slot and a waiting room. A panel round needs a longer slot and its own passcode. Name each template after the stage, so a coordinator can pick the right one without asking you.
What to store in each template

items: A topic pattern with the role, the stage, and your company name.
Waiting room on, so candidates wait in a queue until you admit them.
A passcode, so only people with the invite can get in.
Automatically record meeting, only if your company allows recording and you have told the candidate.
A length that fits the stage, so the next call does not start late.

blocks.text: Zoom waiting room, passcode and sign-in settings for candidates

headers: What it does for a candidate
rows: Holds the candidate until you admit them
Asks for a code before the candidate can join
Admits only people signed in to Zoom. Test it first, because a candidate without a Zoom account may be blocked
Starts recording when the meeting starts, without a manual click
blocks.caption: Scheduler options as listed in Zoom's scheduling article

blocks.text: Use the waiting room for every candidate call, even one-on-one calls. It takes one click to admit someone. It also stops a late or unexpected guest from joining before you are ready.
Admins can lock some of these options at account or group level. If you cannot change a setting, your admin may have locked it. Ask before you work around it.
Meeting IDs expire, so plan reused links

A recurring meeting ID expires 365 days after its last occurrence starts. A non-recurring meeting ID expires 30 days after the meeting is scheduled. The rule matters when you reuse one link for a panel series or a long hiring push.

Say you book a weekly panel. The ID stays valid for 365 days after the last session. A one-off interview ID lapses 30 days after scheduling, even if nobody joins. If a link must last longer, schedule a new meeting closer to the date.
How to record a Zoom interview on Mac

items: Open the Zoom Workplace desktop app and join the meeting as host.
In the meeting toolbar, click Record.
If Zoom offers it, choose Record on this Computer.
Tell the candidate you are recording before the call starts, and wait for their answer.
Keep the Mac plugged in until the file appears, as a precaution.

blocks.text: Zoom's recording article lists no keyboard shortcut for computer recording. It says a Basic (free) account or above is enough, and it names no paid-plan limit. If you are not the host, the host must grant Allow Record from the Participants panel first.
Where Zoom saves recordings on your Mac

On macOS, Zoom saves computer recordings to /Users/[Username]/Documents/Zoom by default. Replace [Username] with your macOS account name. In Finder, choose Go > Home, then open Documents, then Zoom. Press ⇧⌘H to jump to your home folder.

A computer recording is a file on your Mac. Move finished files to the folder your HR or legal team names, then delete the local copy when your policy allows it. Do not leave candidate video sitting in Documents by default.
Tell candidates how you use the recording. Consent rules vary by state and country, so ask your legal team before you record a hiring call.
Mistakes recruiters make with Zoom on Mac

items: Leaving the waiting room off, then admitting strangers at the last minute.
Reusing a link past its expiry rule. Check the 365 day and 30 day limits before you reuse one.
Turning on a template with calendar integration off, so the Template option has nothing to apply.
Trying to record from the browser. Computer recording needs the desktop app.
Clicking Don't send and assuming the candidate saw nothing. The meeting still appears on their calendar.
Ignoring the update prompt. Optional updates can wait, but required updates must install before you continue.

blocks.text: Mac Zoom updates that moved recruiter buttons in 2026
Zoom changed the Mac app several times this year. If a button seems missing, check your build first. These four releases matter most for recruiters.

rows: The AI Companion icon left the header. Each product tab now has its own side-panel entry point
Breakout Rooms moved into the right panel. The AI Companion name was retired
Host Tools reorganized for faster access. The share picker became one scrollable surface
Current release, build 90525, per Zoom's release notes
blocks.caption: Changes from Zoom's release notes for the Zoom Workplace app

blocks.text: The 7.2.0 change matters most if you run the call. Host Tools holds the host controls. Zoom moved them for faster access, so your old habits may point at the wrong spot.

blocks.title: Check your version first
blocks.text: Open the app menu at the top left of the menu bar, then look for About Zoom or Check for Updates. Compare what you see with 7.2.5. If you are behind, update before your first interview of the week.
Where Lazur fits into a recruiter's Zoom day

Lazur is a voice assistant for the Mac that lives in the notch. Hold ⌥⌘, which is Option plus Command, to ask about anything on screen. Lazur answers out loud. It also points. Ask where the Template option is, and Lazur draws a circle and a label around it.

Here is how that looks during a hiring week. Before the call, ask Lazur to walk you through the scheduler one click at a time. During the call, hold ⌥⌘ to find the Record button when you forget where it sits. After the call, hold fn and dictate your notes into your email app.

items: Hold ⌥⌘ and ask where the waiting room setting is. Lazur circles it.
Ask Lazur to guide you through starting a recording. It waits for each click.
Hold fn to dictate a candidate summary at the cursor, in any app.
Keep a snippet for the standard reminder you send before every panel.
Ask Lazur to remind you to send the summary after the call.

blocks.text: Lazur does not click buttons, edit files, or operate other apps for you. It is not a plugin or add-in for Zoom. It has no partnership with Zoom or any other app maker. Your hands stay on the mouse.

Lazur listens and looks at the screen only while you hold the shortcut. Audio and the screenshot go to AI providers so they can answer you, and they are not stored. Content is never used to train AI models.
Test the setup before your first candidate

items: Schedule a test meeting with the template you plan to use.
Join it from a second device and check that the waiting room holds you.
Record a short test with Record on this Computer.
Find the file in Documents > Zoom and confirm it opens.
Start your Lazur trial. It needs no credit card and starts the first time you open the app.

blocks.text: Ask a colleague to join the test with you. A second person catches the things you miss. The waiting room will hold them, so tell them to ask you to admit them.
Zoom or another tool for each candidate

In a Pin sample of more than 39,000 video candidate meetings, Zoom hosted 19.6%. Google Meet hosted 52.9%, and Microsoft Teams hosted 27.2%. Pin is a vendor, and its sampling method is not described. Treat these as a rough signal, not a market count.
Ask each candidate which tool they already use, and match it when you can. If they need Zoom, you now have the steps above.
Why scheduling speed matters for candidates

Employer data points the same way. Employ's 2026 Recruiter Nation Report found that 29% of recruiters say scheduling and rescheduling cause avoidable hiring delays. The figure comes through Jobvite's summary, not Employ's full report.

Cronofy reports that 42% of candidates left when scheduling took too long. The page does not state its sample size, so treat it as a signal. A 2015 Futurestep survey of 700 executives found nearly three-fourths of companies used real-time video to interview leading candidates. That data is old, so use it as history.
For you, the lesson is practical. Set the invite up once with a template, check the link, and send it the same day you agree on the time.

faq.question: Can I schedule Zoom interviews on Mac without a paid plan?
faq.answer: Zoom's recording article says a Basic (free) account or above is enough for computer recording. The same article names no paid-plan limit for it. For scheduling limits, check Zoom's pricing page.

faq.question: Where does Zoom save a recording on a Mac?
faq.answer: By default, Zoom saves computer recordings to /Users/[Username]/Documents/Zoom. In Finder, choose Go > Home, then open Documents and Zoom. You can also reach the files from the Zoom Workplace desktop app.

faq.question: Why is the Template option missing from my scheduler?
faq.answer: Templates need calendar integration turned on. They also work only on Windows or macOS. Turn on calendar integration, then reopen the scheduling window. If it is still missing, ask your admin, since admins can lock some settings.

faq.question: What happens when I click Don't send?
faq.answer: The invite is not delivered to the candidate. The meeting still appears on the invitee's calendar, though. Use Don't send when you want to hold the invite and still block the time.

faq.question: How long does a Zoom interview link stay active?
faq.answer: A recurring meeting ID expires 365 days after its last occurrence starts. A non-recurring meeting ID expires 30 days after the meeting is scheduled. Schedule a new meeting if a link must last longer.

faq.question: Can Lazur click Zoom buttons for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or operate other apps. It points at things, draws a circle and a label, and walks you through steps one click at a time while it waits for you. It is not a plugin for Zoom.

faq.question: Do I need to tell candidates I am recording?
faq.answer: Tell them before the call starts, and wait for their answer. Consent rules vary by state and country, so ask your legal or HR team which rules apply where you hire.

faq.question: Why did my Host Tools menu change?
faq.answer: Zoom Workplace 7.2.0, released September 18, 2026, reorganized Host Tools for faster access to host controls. Check your version, then look at the new layout before your next panel.

faq.question: Does Lazur listen to my interviews all the time?
faq.answer: No. Lazur listens and looks at the screen only while you hold the shortcut. Audio and the screenshot go to AI providers to answer you, and they are not stored.

faq.question: Is Lazur available on Windows?
faq.answer: Not yet. Lazur runs on macOS, on Apple silicon and Intel Macs. Windows is planned, not available.
